## ctxloom deps unhold

Release a hold so `upgrade` can advance the dependency again

### Synopsis

Clear the hold flag on a bundle's active lockfile entry. The next
'ctxloom deps upgrade' may advance it to the newest commit its version
constraint allows.

```
ctxloom deps unhold <name> [flags]
```
